profile.headline: Professional Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Having worked extensively with the Java language for over 12 years to provide companies with business solutions in a wide variety of verticals (health care, transportation, travel, finance, and government), I am looking for a position that will allow me to take full advantage of my experience.

Specialties: J2EE, Oracle 10g, Oracle Portal Server, ClearCase, ClearQuest Toplink, JMS, EJB3.0, Message Driven Beans, EJB 2.0, AJAX, JSP, Struts,J2EE, MS SQL Server, WebSphere Application Server, UModel UML Modeling Tool, WSAD (WebSphere Application Developer), XML, XSLT, Web Services, Jaxb

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented the Brochure Request functionality and administrative modules for the Disneyland Resort Paris Sales and Booking Client.  This is a Web based call center application written in J2EE, Struts, and JSP that communicates via web services to various third party systems to create complex bookings for vacations to DRP.

Technologies used: J2EE, SQL Server, EJB 2.0, AJAX, JSP, Struts

positions.title: Senior Consutlant
positions.description:
Designed and implemented Checkin Modules and Error Logging from the Mobile Computing Environment (MCE) to the web based Office Computing Environment (OCE) for  the Field Data Collection Automation (FDCA) project for the 2010 Decennial Census.  This project consisted of a web based office computing environment link through JMS to approx. 500k handheld computing devices.  The office web based system linked to the MAF/TIGER geographical system as well as other federal information sources through a distributed Oracle 10g database.  Participated and held code and quality reviews, coordinated complex code changes with multiple development groups, and maintained a high standard of work throughout the contract.

Technologies used: J2EE, Oracle 10g, Oracle Portal Server, Oracle Application Developer ClearCase, ClearQuest Toplink, JMS, EJB3.0, Message Driven Beans, JSP, Struts 2.0, Oracle Portlets

Clearences Obtained:  Position of Public Trust

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Software Engineer							March 2005 – September 2007
Siemens Shared Services, LLC	Orlando, Florida

Designed and implemented the eInvoice system for Shared Services.  The eInvoice system is responsible for the electronic processing of vendor invoices directly into SSL's internal web based workflow system, EZSuite.  Over 50,000 invoices are received each month and are processed by the system.  Invoices are sent in a custom XML format which is transformed using XSLT into a standard internal invoice.  Business unit specific logic is applied and the invoice is then exported into the EZSuite system.   Designed and implemented the eVoucher system for Shared Services.  The eVoucher application is a custom implemented SAP integrated rules-based engine that applies SOC (Siemens Operating Company) specific logic to an invoice before posting it electronically into SAP using either JCO or Web Services.
Responsible for integrating seven operating companies into the eInvoice and eVoucher systems, including Siemens Power Generation (formerly Westinghouse), Siemens Automotive, Siemens Communications, and Siemens Building Technologies.

Technologies used: J2EE, MS SQL Server, WebSphere Application Server, UModel UML Modeling Tool, WSAD (WebSphere Application Developer), XML, XSLT, Struts, Web Services, Jaxb
